title: Prepare eve 0.4.0 release
summary: Added a local release-preparation script and used it to prepare the 0.4.0 release metadata.
userVisibleChange: Maintainers can run scripts/prepare-release.sh <version> to update npm release metadata and promote Unreleased changelog entries into a dated release section. The script was run for 0.4.0.

risks.title: Changelog release section is not idempotent
risks.mitigation: The script fails if the target release section already exists, preventing duplicate release headings on accidental reruns.

timeline.title: Locked release-prep plan
timeline.summary: Declared and locked the EVE plan for adding a release script and preparing 0.4.0.

timeline.title: Added release script
timeline.summary: Created scripts/prepare-release.sh to validate semver input, update npm/eve package metadata, and promote changelog notes into a dated release section.

timeline.title: Prepared 0.4.0 metadata
timeline.summary: Ran scripts/prepare-release.sh 0.4.0, producing the 2026-07-26 changelog section and @nhestrompia/eve 0.4.0 package metadata.

timeline.title: Reviewed staged implementation
timeline.summary: Ran standards and spec review agents; fixed the script's next-step guidance to include the required EVE record commit.

timeline.title: Verified release preparation
timeline.summary: Ran focused package checks, Go tests, shell syntax validation, and the full local verification script.

decisions.title: Use npm version for npm metadata
decisions.rationale: npm already updates package.json and package-lock.json consistently, avoiding ad hoc JSON edits for package metadata.

decisions.title: Keep Git tagging outside the script
decisions.rationale: The existing GitHub release workflow publishes from pushed v* tags; the local script prepares committed release metadata and prints the follow-up release steps without mutating Git refs.
